:::{#def-bound}
#### Lower bound and upper bound

For a [subset](#def-subset) $S \subseteq \reals$ of the [real numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers),
a [real number](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) $a$ is a **lower bound** of $S$ if $a \le x$ for every $x \in S$,
and a real number $b$ is an **upper bound** of $S$ if $x \le b$ for every $x \in S$;
each is a **bound** of $S$.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-interval}
#### Interval

An **interval**
[@wikipedia_interval_mathematics]
is a [subset](#def-subset) of the [real numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers)
that consists of all real numbers between two bounds $a \le b$ (@def-bound),
possibly including one or both bounds,
or of all real numbers on one side of a single bound,
or all of $\reals$.
The bounds $a$ and $b$ that define the interval are its **endpoints**.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-closed-interval}
#### Closed interval

For [real numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) $a \le b$,
the **closed interval** is the interval (@def-interval) $[a, b] \eqdef \set{x \in \reals : a \le x \le b}$
that includes both bounds (@def-bound).

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-open-interval}
#### Open interval

For [real numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) $a \le b$,
the **open interval** is the interval (@def-interval) $(a, b) \eqdef \set{x \in \reals : a < x < b}$
that includes neither bound (@def-bound).

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-half-open-interval}
#### Half-open intervals

For [real numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) $a \le b$,
the **half-open intervals** are the intervals (@def-interval) $[a, b) \eqdef \set{x \in \reals : a \le x < b}$
and $(a, b] \eqdef \set{x \in \reals : a < x \le b}$
that include one bound (@def-bound) and not the other.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#def-unbounded-interval}
#### Unbounded intervals

For [real numbers](number-systems.qmd#def-real-numbers) $a$ and $b$,
the **unbounded intervals** are the intervals (@def-interval) with at most one bound (@def-bound):

- $[a, \infty) \eqdef \set{x \in \reals : x \ge a}$
  and $(a, \infty) \eqdef \set{x \in \reals : x > a}$;
- $(-\infty, b] \eqdef \set{x \in \reals : x \le b}$
  and $(-\infty, b) \eqdef \set{x \in \reals : x < b}$;
- $(-\infty, \infty) \eqdef \reals$.

:::
